description: Letter to Alfred Stieglitz from Georgia O'Keeffe while she was in New Mexico. She mentions Arthur and Phoebe Pack of Ghost Ranch in the letter.
imageCaption: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz, 1942-10-08. Letters to Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz
